descriptions.d29d_worm_drown_80149f18: Worm drowning check. Returns if already drowning or above the water level minus the drown height. Otherwise clears hit points, flags death, posts a message, clears links; a shallow fall sets state 27 and zero velocity, deep water sets state 19, a timer and a splash at the water surface, with log lines. Damps the velocity. If the active index is valid, either posts a message for the current turn object, or for the same team picks the nearest living worm in range and posts it as the next.
